description: This file contains client-side JavaScript code for an OpenCart project, implementing UI behaviors such as tooltips, form submissions via AJAX, button states, upload handling, autocomplete functionality, and product display toggles.

methods.name: oc_tooltip
methods.description: Initializes and shows Bootstrap tooltip on mouseenter.

methods.name: observe
methods.description: Defines a jQuery plugin to observe DOM mutations.

methods.name: button
methods.description: Defines a jQuery plugin to toggle button states (loading, reset).

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles AJAX form submission for forms marked with 'data-oc-toggle="ajax"'.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles file upload via AJAX when buttons with 'data-oc-toggle="upload"' are clicked.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides autocomplete dropdown functionality for input fields.
